user.title: Restart Guard
user.description: Warns you in Home Assistant's own restart dialog when a timed automation is about to run.

data.warn_window: Warn if an automation is due within
data.min_interval: Ignore automations repeating more often than
data.check_conditions: Stay quiet when conditions can't pass
data.scheduler_path: Dashboard your scheduler card is on

data_description.warn_window: How close counts as too close to restart.
data_description.lookahead: Automations further out than this are not tracked.
data_description.min_interval: Stops every-5-minutes automations from warning constantly.
data_description.check_conditions: Don't warn about an automation that would fire and do nothing, because its conditions don't pass or no choose branch matches. Turn this off to warn about every scheduled run regardless.
data_description.track_schedules: Include schedules from the Scheduler component (nielsfaber). Only enabled schedules count - a disabled one keeps publishing a next trigger time it will never act on.
data_description.track_control_center: Include upcoming climate-schedule fires from the Control Center add-on, read from the sensor it publishes.
data_description.control_center_entity: The sensor Control Center publishes upcoming fires on. Default sensor.control_center_schedules.
data_description.control_center_path: Where a Control Center row opens, e.g. its sidebar/ingress path. Leave empty and the row opens the sensor dialog instead.
data_description.open_on_tap: Tap an automation, script or schedule in the warning to go straight to it.
data_description.scheduler_path: Only for schedules. Enter the dashboard your scheduler card is on, for example /lovelace/scheduler. Leave empty and the row opens the entity dialog instead.

set_open_on_tap.name: Set open on tap
set_open_on_tap.description: Records whether tapping a row in the restart warning should open what it is about. The warning calls this itself when you answer its prompt; the same setting is in the integration's options.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether a tap opens the automation, script or schedule.
